transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to complete in the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each session needs a two-hour block. Before I sign off on the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Training NCO, what's the status on the forklift certification course? Motor pool sergeant, where do we stand on the generator refresher? And safety officer, what's the latest on the hazmat refresher? I also need to know if there are any facility or safety constraints I should be aware of before I lock in the schedule.

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a critical constraint on the forklift certification.
